description: This file contains implementation code for managing Kubernetes CronJobs and Jobs, including interfaces and their implementations for controlling CronJob status and Job creation/deletion, with real and fake versions for testing.

classes.name: cjControlInterface
classes.description: Interface for controlling CronJob status, including updating status and retrieving CronJobs.

classes.name: realCJControl
classes.description: Default implementation of cjControlInterface using real Kubernetes client.

classes.name: fakeCJControl
classes.description: Fake implementation of cjControlInterface for testing, with in-memory storage.

classes.name: jobControlInterface
classes.description: Interface for managing Jobs, including getting, creating, and deleting Jobs.

classes.name: realJobControl
classes.description: Default implementation of jobControlInterface using real Kubernetes client.

classes.name: fakeJobControl
classes.description: Fake implementation of jobControlInterface for testing, with in-memory storage and synchronization.

methods.name: UpdateStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a CronJob in Kubernetes.

methods.name: CreateJob
methods.description: Creates a new Job in Kubernetes.
